title: Lexmark CS/CX73x Cyan Return Program Toner 12.5K

comparisons.notes: Lexmark 71C1XC0 cyan return program toner, 12,500-page yield for CS/CX73x, new, free shipping
Same Lexmark 71C1XC0 cyan 12.5K return program cartridge, free shipping
Listing titled 'Lexmark LXK CS/X73x RTN 12.5K CRTG Cyan', identical item, marketplace seller

writeup: This is Lexmark's genuine cyan Return Program cartridge for the CS730, CS735 and CX730 color lasers, rated for about 12,500 pages. Woot has it at $199.99, while the same cartridge runs $346.02 at NextWarehouse, $378.99 at Office Depot and $390.63 at Best Buy. Return Program cartridges are meant to go back to Lexmark for recycling after use.
